status: Specified after the primary conditional-line result was known, before this fixed-K decomposition was computed

definitions.A_B_C_D: At K: a=count R, b=sum R*O4, c=sum R*s, d=sum R*O4*s; s=CB+CW bulk; b,d complex
definitions.weights: Normalized exact Binomial(N,p0) weights, using the already saved central/aligned-delete-one source root
definitions.Ctotal: sum_k w_k*d_k / sum_k w_k*a_k - conditional_mean_O4*conditional_mean_s = within+between
definitions.moving_nu: Ctotal + rootdot_s*mu_p; moving_nu, mu_p and primary E residual are copied from the same primary central/delete-one vector
definitions.rootclock: rootdot_s*mu_p; p changes only the K mixture, not the fixed-K conditional distribution
definitions.null: within=0 for any source f_g(K,q,E), allowed to vary by geometry; q=E=0 in rank one. A nonzero within is a line-associated spatial-configuration coupling at fixed occupancy and topology, not an energy-operator identity

small_count_sensitivity.primary: Unmodified plug-in covariance decomposition on all K; no selected analysis window
small_count_sensitivity.zero_count: a=0 requires b=c=d=0 and contributes zero; empirical zero does not prove population absence
small_count_sensitivity.singleton: The empirical plug-in within is zero at a=1, not evidence that the population covariance vanishes
small_count_sensitivity.bessel: For a>1 multiply d-b*c/a by a/(a-1); a<=1 contributes zero only to this sensitivity, with its omitted empirical rank-one mass explicitly reported. Do not replace primary within or combine this sensitivity with unmodified between as an exact identity
small_count_sensitivity.counts: Report all per-K counts, binomial mass and empirical rank-one mass at a<=1, minimum positive count and minimum count in the binomial central quantile range; this range is diagnostic only
small_count_sensitivity.effect_on_research: A reported sensitivity, not a permission or continuation gate

comparisons: Four-real within vector per N and a jointly covaried 24-real six-N vector; retain covariance-supported rank and nominal p, not independent votes
dependence: Inherit primary three source groups, exact old-counter nested endpoint batch unions and 100 aligned omissions. Copy primary/source saved vectors; no complement anchor, root finder, new replay or Monte Carlo sample
interpretation: This uses K-resolved information absent from a single Bernoulli aggregate, but shares every observation with the primary E+clock/wedge experiment. O4 is constant within each nonempty filtration rank-one window; a fixed-K coupling does not separately identify birth selection or lifetime selection
